digest.component_or_area: Pandoc markdown conversion and configuration resolution
propositions: _convert resolves _pandoc_timeout() on every invocation, causing redundant git rev-parse --show-toplevel subprocesses (886 extra for 884 conversions).
The 884-unit hardening oracle performs 1,770 total Popen calls (884 Pandoc + 886 git-root probes) instead of 887 (884 Pandoc + 3 root probes).

Timeout resolution must be moved to render-pass boundary and threaded through _render_unit and _convert via optional parameters while preserving all 884 real Pandoc invocations and byte-exact outputs.
Per-unit timeout fallback, Pandoc stdin/argv behavior, whole-process-group reaping, and non-default timeout configuration between render passes must remain functionally identical.
A held-out oracle with three renderable units must validate exactly one _pandoc_timeout() resolution per render pass and show RED→GREEN→defect-RED→GREEN test cycle.
Fresh 884-unit trace must preserve 884 real Pandoc calls, byte-equivalence to immutable expected outputs, and reduce git-root probes to at most 3 one-time cold path invocations.
